notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: There was a known bug where the progress could not be saved completely and players would loose hixcoins, viruses or any other software while there mission progress was intact. I have fixed this issue and there shouldn't be a problem with the saving mechanism anymore. If you find any more bugs, don't forget to make a post about it! Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Bug Fixes for Hacker.exe
notes.notes: Hello dear players! I have been working on fixing a nasty bug that prohinited many players from accessing the message tab on the phone because the game would crash. This has been fixed now and should work accordingly. Please don't hesitate if you find any other bug. Thank you for playing and keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: Hacker.exe is available for MAC OS + Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Hey everyone! I hope everyone is enjoying the game so far! I just wanted all those Mac gamers that [b]Hacker.exe[/b] is now [b]availble[/b] for Mac! The game now has a couple of bug fixes such as an increase in the VPN time and also a now a save feature that will not restart the game from the beggining if you get caught and loose. Note that there is still a possibility of you having to start over when you get caught in certain cutscenes, so keep your eyes opened! Enjoy the game everyone! I will be checking around the forums for more bugs/recommendations and improve the game as so!

notes.title: Black Friday Sale! Get 80% Off Hacker.exe!
Language Support Added!
notes.notes:
[h1]You can now change languages for the messages that are sent![/h1]
So it's been requested for a while and now it's here! You can choose between Spanish, English, Russian and French! Choose these languages and feel more comfortable while playing. Just go to the settings in the main menu and from there just change the language. The text that is effected is in game, so that means that the main screen won't have a drastic change(working on that). You will see a change though when you enter the game and get instructions on what to do, that includes the tutorial. If you have any other feature that you would like to have in the game, leave a post in the discussions

notes.title: Minimizing Tab Added!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing and downloading Hacker.exe! The game has been updated with a new feature. You can now minimize the browser tab and still have your current webpage opened. In this way, all of your progress on any website will be stored when you minimize the browsing window. I would really like some feedback and like to know what you guys think! If you have any more suggestions, make sure to create threads with any new content you wish to see for this game! A new background has also been added, make sure to check out the new galaxy themed background! For those users that prefer the galaxy them on mac, here is something for all of you!  Enjoy the update!
